page.layout: One page with one table of calendar columns, headed by a column-title line. Columns from left to right: Indiction, Anni Iulian, Litera dominicalis, Nabonassar, Feriae, a column of notes for the Ian. dates, and Christi years. The page has a catchword-free foot with the signature "Gg" and no marginal text.

main_text.l: Indi&t. | Anni Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabonasari. | Feriæ. | | Christi.

page.notes: The table has two horizontal rules, after the 15th row of the first block and after the 15th row of the second block, which are not transcribed. The entry "a1627" carries an italic a, read as printed. The column of Ian. dates is a side column of the table, not a margin note. Specks in the margins are not text and are omitted. The Gg mark is followed by a small ▼ that is not transcribed.
